req.title: Task title trimmed of whitespace
req.statement: The system shall trim leading and trailing whitespace from the title on POST /tasks/.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-037 requires that POST /tasks/ trims leading and trailing whitespace from the task title before persisting it. The test suite must verify: (1) positive — a title with surrounding whitespace is stored trimmed; (2) negative — a title that is only whitespace becomes empty after trimming and should be rejected (min_length=1 enforces this); (3) boundary — a title with exactly one non-whitespace character surrounded by whitespace trims to exactly that character (BVA at min_length boundary). Additional cases cover leading-only, trailing-only, and internal whitespace (internal spaces must NOT be trimmed). All assertions use exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_title_leading_and_trailing_whitespace_trimmed
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: POST /tasks/ with title '   Buy milk   ' (leading and trailing spaces)
trace: R-TASK-037: system shall trim leading and trailing whitespace from title
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine
from app import models

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_title_leading_and_trailing_whitespace_trimmed():
    payload = {"title": "   Buy milk   ", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Buy milk"
    assert body["title"] != "   Buy milk   "
    assert body["title"] != "Buy milk   "
    assert body["title"] != "   Buy milk"
